questions.prompt: When the general had been killed, the whole army became fearful.
questions.answer: Duce interfectō, tōtus exercitus timidus factus est.

questions.prompt: The boy is becoming wiser day by day.
questions.answer: Puer in diēs sapientior fit.

questions.prompt: Let us become braver, so that we may conquer the enemy.
questions.answer: Fortiōrēs fīāmus ut hostēs vincāmus.

questions.prompt: These things were done by the consul without any delay.
questions.answer: Haec sine morā ā cōnsule facta sunt.

questions.prompt: If you become a soldier, you will endure many hardships.
questions.answer: Sī mīles fīēs, multa incommoda patiēris.

questions.prompt: The waters, mixed with wine, became sweeter.
questions.answer: Aquae vīnō mixtae dulciōrēs factae sunt.

questions.prompt: Nothing is made without a cause.
questions.answer: Nihil sine causā fit.

questions.prompt: As night was drawing near, the forest became silent.
questions.answer: Nocte appropinquante silva tacita facta est.

questions.prompt: We fear that the boys may become idle.
questions.answer: Verēmur nē puerī ignāvī fīant.

questions.prompt: After the king had been made a captive, the city surrendered itself.
questions.answer: Rēge captīvō factō, urbs sē dēdidit.

questions.prompt: May you become worthy of so great an honor.
questions.answer: Tantō honōre dignus fīās.

questions.prompt: The soldiers were growing weary from the long march.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs longō itinere fessī fīēbant.

questions.prompt: It happened that the messenger arrived at midnight.
questions.answer: Factum est ut nūntius mediā nocte advenīret.

questions.prompt: Whatever is done wisely is worthy of praise.
questions.answer: Quidquid sapienter fit laude dignum est.

questions.prompt: Let the frightened crowd become calm.
questions.answer: Turba territa placida fīat.

questions.prompt: The words spoken by the poet became well known.
questions.answer: Verba ā poētā dicta nōta facta sunt.

questions.prompt: You will become richer if you work diligently.
questions.answer: Dītior fīēs sī dīligenter labōrābis.

questions.prompt: While the war was being waged, many were made slaves.
questions.answer: Dum bellum geritur, multī servī factī sunt.

questions.prompt: So great an uproar arose that the leaders fell silent.
questions.answer: Tantus tumultus factus est ut ducēs tacērent.

questions.prompt: When her father's voice had been heard, the girl became joyful.
questions.answer: Puella, vōce patris audītā, laeta facta est.

questions.prompt: Let us not become slaves to fear.
questions.answer: Nē timōris servī fīāmus.

questions.prompt: These fields are becoming barren through neglect.
questions.answer: Hī agrī neglegentiā sterilēs fīunt.

questions.prompt: He asked what would become of the captured citizens.
questions.answer: Rogāvit quid dē cīvibus captīs fieret.
